### Visible Objects and Marks
In [candidate.png](file:///tmp/blind-t4tfwcqh/candidate.png), a dark circular button with a thin grey outer border sits centered against a dark charcoal background. Inside the circle are two crossed broadswords arranged in an "X" with their silver/off-white beveled blades pointing toward the upper-left and upper-right (the sword angled from bottom-right to top-left overlaps the other). Both swords have bluish-grey crossguards, brown grips, and rounded bluish-grey pommels at the bottom.

### Best Action Interpretation
* **Action:** **Attack / Initiate Combat** (use the selected piece to declare an attack or enter melee/combat mode).
* **Confidence:** **High** (or **Medium** regarding the exact mechanical trigger, as noted below).

### Ambiguity & Alternative
* **Why it is slightly ambiguous:** Crossed swords universally denote combat, but in a generic 3D virtual tabletop (as opposed to a rules-enforced wargame) contextual menus on a piece often toggle token states rather than adjudicate attack rolls.
* **Plausible alternative:** **Toggle Combat / Hostile Status** (marking the piece as in-combat, adding it to the initiative tracker, or applying a "fighting/engaged" status badge).
